items.title: Write-time hooks: `beforeWrite` (can veto) and `afterWrite`, in load order
Proof currency: a registry-level predicate plus a `refutes` status flag
Cross-branch views read every local worktree's disk, local branches only
Slug uniqueness: check unmerged local refs at creation, uuid fallback
Lock trust policy: refuse a changed source; verifiers declare `runs`
Triage fallbacks: middle for impact/priority, worst for effort
